summary_en: On November 5, 2026, the board authorized a single-day share buyback via ToSTNeT-3 at the closing price of 2,911 yen on that date. The company will purchase up to 200,000 shares (3.06% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of 582.2 million yen on November 6, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On November 5, 2026, the Board of Directors of THE KEIHIN CO., LTD. approved a share buyback to be executed the following morning via off-market trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will purchase up to 200,000 shares at a fixed price of 2,911 yen per share (the closing price on November 5), with a maximum cash outlay of 582.2 million yen. This represents 3.1% of outstanding shares (6,528,538 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The purchase order will be placed on the morning of November 6, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. in the ToSTNeT-3 session and is valid for that trading session only. Results will be announced immediately after the session closes. The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. As noted in the disclosure, there is a possibility that the company may not execute the full amount of the order depending on market conditions.
